annotations.title: Keep a clip to use again

description: Keep one finished output of a video (a clip, a hook or the main video, by its output_id from check_video) as a reusable asset. Its asset_id goes in asset_ids of edit_video or create_video, so the clip can open another video, sit inside one or become the whole video. For a picture or song from outside Clypmint, use import_asset. Cost: Free: no credits.

output_id.description: The clip (or hook, or main film) to keep, from check_video, e.g. short-2-9x16.

name: save_clip

outputSchema.description: Clypmint save_clip result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.
